reviewed.note: A penetration-testing toolkit; its 63 YARA and 25 high hits are what it is for, read by kind: 'keylogging' matches 'Grabs credentials' in the example scripts' help text, process-memory names (mimikatz, lsass, secretsdump, ReadProcessMemory in an error table), raw sockets in ping.py, the 70 console scripts (examples) it installs. axross uses impacket.smbconnection, dcerpc and wmi for its SMB/WMI backends and never imports impacket.examples, which replaces ssl.create_default_context process-wide (a test holds that).
